_about: LayerFlow agent catalogue — the single source of truth. Read by the API (app/platform/catalog_agents.py) and copied into the dashboard demo (apps/web/lib/demo/catalog-agents.json) by scripts/sync_catalog.py; a test fails if they differ. 'preset' is the config applied when a customer activates the agent (validated against the engine's config schema in tests). 'everyday_use' is the one plain-language line non-technical users see first.

agents.name: Smart Web Scraper
agents.tagline: Tell it what you want from any website
agents.description: Paste a website and describe the information you want in plain words (for example: product name, price, rating). It reads the pages, follows 'next page' links and returns clean rows. No coding or selectors needed.
agents.everyday_use: Turn any website list into a clean spreadsheet.
capabilities: AI extraction from plain-language field names
Works with RSS, sitemaps and JSON
example_workflows: Scrape listings → Clean & sort → Save to dataset

agents.name: URL Collector
agents.tagline: Gather every link that matters
agents.description: Collects links from pages, sitemaps and search results, keeps only the ones matching your pattern (like /product/ or /event/), removes duplicates and tracking junk, and hands them to the next agent.
agents.everyday_use: Get the full list of product, article or event pages on a site.
example_workflows: URL Collector → Smart Web Scraper → Dataset Saver

agents.name: Site Crawler
agents.tagline: Walk a whole website, page by page
agents.description: Starts from a homepage or sitemap and visits pages up to the depth and limit you set, collecting each page's title, text, headings and links. Great as the first step for audits, research and content inventories.
agents.everyday_use: Make a full inventory of your own or a competitor's website.
example_workflows: Site Crawler → SEO Site Auditor → Report Builder

agents.name: Table Extractor
agents.tagline: Copy tables off any page, cleanly
agents.description: Finds every HTML table on the pages you give it (fees, timetables, price lists, rankings) and turns each row into structured data with proper column names and numbers.
agents.everyday_use: Grab fee tables, price lists or rankings without retyping.
example_workflows: Table Extractor → Change Detector → Alerts

agents.name: Structured Data Reader
agents.tagline: Read the hidden data websites publish
agents.description: Many sites publish machine-readable details (schema.org JSON-LD, Open Graph, microdata) for products, events, recipes, jobs and articles. This agent reads them directly: fast, exact and with no AI guessing.
agents.everyday_use: Get exact prices, dates and ratings that sites already publish for Google.
example_workflows: URL Collector → Structured Data Reader → Comparison Builder

agents.name: Image Scraper
agents.tagline: Collect the images from any page
agents.description: Collects images from the pages you choose: main image, gallery and Open Graph image. Small icons are skipped, the size and alt text are kept, and each picture gets an image hash so duplicates are removed automatically.
agents.everyday_use: Collect product, campus or event photos with duplicates removed.
example_workflows: Smart Web Scraper → Image Scraper → Dataset Saver

pricing.note: Only use images you have the right to use.

agents.name: Open-License Image Finder
agents.tagline: Free-to-use pictures for every post
agents.description: Finds pictures for your topics from open-license libraries first (Openverse and Wikimedia Commons), with the licence and the credit line ready to paste. Duplicates are removed by image hash.
agents.everyday_use: Get a free, properly credited picture for every article.
capabilities: CC0 / CC BY / public domain first
example_workflows: Content Writer → Open-License Image Finder → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Image Alt-Text Writer
agents.tagline: Accessible descriptions for every image
agents.description: Writes short, accurate alt text and captions for images, which helps accessibility and SEO. It uses a vision model when one is installed; otherwise it writes from the page context and the existing caption.
agents.everyday_use: Make every image accessible and better for Google.
example_workflows: Image Scraper → Image Alt-Text Writer → Dataset Saver

agents.name: News Discovery
agents.tagline: Fresh stories on your topics, every hour
agents.description: Watches Google News and your chosen feeds for your keywords, removes duplicates and old stories, and gives you only what's new.
agents.everyday_use: Never miss news about your market, competitors or city.
example_workflows: News Discovery → Content Writer → Multi-format Creator → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Topic & Feed Monitor
agents.tagline: Follow the feeds and blogs you trust
agents.description: Follows the RSS feeds, blogs and announcement pages you add and passes along new posts as they appear.
agents.everyday_use: One place for every blog and notice board you follow.
example_workflows: Topic & Feed Monitor → Summarizer → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: Research Analyst
agents.tagline: Cited answers from the open web
agents.description: Give it a question or topic. It finds sources, reads them and writes a short research brief where every fact links to where it came from.
agents.everyday_use: Get a researched brief with sources in minutes.
example_workflows: Research Analyst → Content Writer → SEO Optimizer

agents.name: Data Finder
agents.tagline: Find the exact numbers you need
agents.description: Ask for specific facts (for example 'average placement package at NIT Trichy' or 'GST rate on laptops'). It searches, reads and returns each value with its source and date so you can trust it.
agents.everyday_use: Find a number or fact with the source attached.
example_workflows: Data Finder → Dataset Saver

config.focus: Return the specific values asked for, each with the source it came from.

agents.name: Business Contact Finder
agents.tagline: Public business contact details, organised
agents.description: Reads public 'Contact' and 'About' pages of businesses and organisations and collects the publicly listed email, phone, address and social links. It only reads what the business has published.
agents.everyday_use: Build a clean list of business contacts from their own websites.
example_workflows: URL Collector → Business Contact Finder → Lead Qualifier → CRM Sync

pricing.note: Respect privacy laws; business contacts only.

agents.name: Product & Price Scraper
agents.tagline: Prices, stock and ratings from shops
agents.description: Collects product name, price, MRP, discount, stock and rating from shop pages, using published structured data first and AI extraction second.
agents.everyday_use: Track competitor prices every day.
example_workflows: Product & Price Scraper → Change Detector → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: Job Listings Collector
agents.tagline: Openings from career pages and job boards
agents.description: Collects job title, company, location, salary, experience and apply link from career pages and job boards that allow it.
agents.everyday_use: Run a job board or track who is hiring.
example_workflows: Job Listings Collector → Data Cleaner & Sorter → Dataset Saver

agents.name: Event & Hackathon Finder
agents.tagline: Upcoming events, hackathons and deadlines
agents.description: Finds upcoming events, hackathons, webinars and contests with dates, deadlines, prizes, mode and registration link.
agents.everyday_use: Keep a live calendar of events and hackathons.
example_workflows: Event & Hackathon Finder → Data Cleaner & Sorter → Content Writer → Dataset Saver

agents.name: Review Collector
agents.tagline: What customers are saying, in one place
agents.description: Collects reviews and ratings that are published on pages you're allowed to read (your own product pages, public review pages) with the date, rating and text.
agents.everyday_use: See all your reviews together and spot complaints early.
example_workflows: Review Collector → Sentiment & Topic Tagger → Report Builder

agents.name: PDF & Document Reader
agents.tagline: Read brochures, notices and reports
agents.description: Opens PDFs and documents from links (brochures, fee notices, annual reports, circulars), pulls out the text and the fields you ask for, and passes them on.
agents.everyday_use: Get the important details out of long PDFs.
example_workflows: URL Collector → PDF & Document Reader → Dataset Saver

agents.name: Page Change Watcher
agents.tagline: Tell me when this page changes
agents.description: Checks the pages you choose on a schedule (or just one part, like a price or a notice list) and reports only what changed since the last check, with before and after.
agents.everyday_use: Get alerted when a price drops, a notice is posted or a date changes.
capabilities: Ignores noise like dates and ads
example_workflows: Page Change Watcher → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: College / Institution Researcher
agents.tagline: Fees, courses, placements into a dataset
agents.description: Visits institution websites and official pages to collect courses, fees, placements, rankings, facilities and admissions details into your dataset, keeping the source of every value.
agents.everyday_use: Keep a college or school directory up to date automatically.
example_workflows: College Researcher → Change Detector → Content Writer

agents.name: Content Writer
agents.tagline: Original articles in your voice
agents.description: Turns collected stories or notes into original articles in your brand voice, using only facts from the sources it was given.
agents.everyday_use: Publish fresh articles every day without writing from scratch.
example_workflows: News Discovery → Content Writer → SEO Optimizer → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Summarizer
agents.tagline: Long pages into short, clear points
agents.description: Turns long articles, notices or reports into a short summary or bullet points that anyone can read in 30 seconds.
agents.everyday_use: Read the gist of anything in 30 seconds.
example_workflows: Topic & Feed Monitor → Summarizer → Alerts & Digest Sender

config.persona: A clear editor who writes summaries anyone can read in 30 seconds.
config.instructions: Write 3–5 short bullet points ('- ') with the key facts, then one line on why it matters. Keep every number, name and date exactly as in the source.

agents.name: Translator
agents.tagline: Your content in Hindi and more
agents.description: Translates content into Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and other languages while keeping names, numbers and formatting intact.
agents.everyday_use: Reach readers in their own language.
example_workflows: Content Writer → Translator → Auto Publisher

pricing.note: Quality depends on the language; review before publishing.

config.persona: A faithful professional translator who keeps names, numbers, dates and formatting exactly.
config.instructions: Translate faithfully. Do not add, remove or reinterpret facts. Keep headings and lists.

agents.name: Multi-format Creator
agents.tagline: One story, every channel
agents.description: Turns one story into an article, LinkedIn post, X thread, Instagram caption, Facebook post, newsletter blurb, WhatsApp message and short-video script, each following that platform's rules.
agents.everyday_use: Post everywhere from one story.
example_workflows: Content Writer → Multi-format Creator → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Social Caption Writer
agents.tagline: Scroll-stopping captions and hashtags
agents.description: Writes Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and X captions with a strong first line, the right length and a few relevant hashtags.
agents.everyday_use: Never stare at an empty caption box again.
example_workflows: Open-License Image Finder → Social Caption Writer → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Newsletter Builder
agents.tagline: Your weekly newsletter, assembled
agents.description: Collects the week's best items and writes a ready-to-send newsletter with an intro, sections and links.
agents.everyday_use: Send a weekly newsletter in minutes.
example_workflows: News Discovery → Newsletter Builder → Alerts & Digest Sender

config.title: This week {{date}}
config.instructions: Write it as a friendly newsletter: a two-line intro, then each item with one line on why it matters.

agents.name: Report Builder
agents.tagline: Daily and weekly reports, written for you
agents.description: Turns what your agents found (leads, prices, changes, audits) into a clear report with highlights, numbers and next steps.
agents.everyday_use: Get a daily summary you can forward to your boss.
example_workflows: Change Detector → Report Builder → Alerts & Digest Sender

config.title: Report {{date}}
config.instructions: Lead with the numbers, then what changed, then 2–3 concrete next steps.

agents.name: FAQ Generator
agents.tagline: FAQs from your own pages
agents.description: Reads your pages or documents and writes the questions customers actually ask, with short answers taken only from your content.
agents.everyday_use: Add a helpful FAQ section to any page.
example_workflows: Site Crawler → FAQ Generator → Dataset Saver → Customer Support Assistant

config.system: You write clear FAQs using only the given content. Never invent prices, dates or policies.

agents.name: Email Drafter
agents.tagline: Polite, clear emails in seconds
agents.description: Drafts follow-up, outreach and reply emails from the details in each item (name, interest, last message) in the tone you choose.
agents.everyday_use: Reply to every enquiry quickly and politely.
example_workflows: Lead Qualifier → Email Drafter → Alerts & Digest Sender

config.system: You write friendly, professional emails. No made-up offers, prices or promises.

agents.name: SEO Optimizer
agents.tagline: Titles, descriptions and schema for every post
agents.description: Writes the SEO title, meta description, clean URL slug, keywords and schema markup for each article so it shows up well on Google and social media.
agents.everyday_use: Make every post Google-ready.
example_workflows: Content Writer → SEO Optimizer → Auto Publisher

agents.name: SEO Site Auditor
agents.tagline: Find what's hurting your rankings
agents.description: Crawls your website and lists every SEO problem (missing titles and descriptions, duplicate titles, missing H1, canonical, social tags, schema, slow or broken pages) with the fix for each.
agents.everyday_use: Get a prioritised SEO fix list for your site.
example_workflows: SEO Site Auditor → Report Builder → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: Broken Link Checker
agents.tagline: No more dead links on your site
agents.description: Checks every link on your pages and lists the broken ones (404s, timeouts, redirects to nowhere) with the page they're on.
agents.everyday_use: Fix broken links before visitors find them.
example_workflows: Broken Link Checker → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: Keyword Researcher
agents.tagline: What people actually search for
agents.description: Expands your topic into the questions and phrases people type into search engines (from free search suggestions), adds terms your competitors use, and groups them by intent.
agents.everyday_use: Know what to write about next.
example_workflows: Keyword Researcher → Content Writer → SEO Optimizer

agents.name: Fact Checker
agents.tagline: Every claim checked against its source
agents.description: Checks the claims and numbers in each item against its sources and marks each one verified, unsupported or contradicted before anything is published.
agents.everyday_use: Publish with confidence, without embarrassing mistakes.
example_workflows: Content Writer → Fact Checker → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Quality Gate
agents.tagline: Stops bad content before it ships
agents.description: Blocks or flags content that is too short or too long, uses banned phrases, repeats a recent post or mentions numbers not found in the source.
agents.everyday_use: Keep your brand's quality bar automatically.
example_workflows: Multi-format Creator → Quality Gate → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Data Cleaner & Sorter
agents.tagline: Remove duplicates, filter, sort
agents.description: Cleans any list: removes duplicates, keeps only what matches your rules (for example 'deadline after today'), sorts by date, number or name, and can sort items into categories with AI.
agents.everyday_use: Turn a messy list into a clean, sorted one.
example_workflows: Event & Hackathon Finder → Data Cleaner & Sorter → Dataset Saver

agents.name: Sentiment & Topic Tagger
agents.tagline: Positive, negative, and what it's about
agents.description: Labels each review, comment or post as positive, neutral or negative and tags the topic (price, delivery, quality, staff…) so you can see patterns at a glance.
agents.everyday_use: See what customers love and what annoys them.
example_workflows: Review Collector → Sentiment & Topic Tagger → Report Builder

agents.name: Comparison Builder
agents.tagline: Side-by-side comparisons, done for you
agents.description: Matches the same product, college, plan or service across different sources, builds a side-by-side table and highlights the best value in each row (lowest price, highest rating…).
agents.everyday_use: Compare prices, plans or colleges across sites in one table.
example_workflows: Product & Price Scraper → Comparison Builder → Auto Publisher

agents.name: Change Detector
agents.tagline: Know when a price, fee or date changes
agents.description: Compares new data with what's already in your dataset and tells you what's new, what changed (with old and new values) and what stayed the same.
agents.everyday_use: Spot every change in prices, fees or dates.
example_workflows: Table Extractor → Change Detector → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: Dataset Saver
agents.tagline: Save results where your website can read them
agents.description: Saves the items from earlier steps into a dataset (creating or updating records), which your website can show through the API or the WordPress table shortcode.
agents.everyday_use: Put collected data on your website automatically.
example_workflows: Smart Web Scraper → Data Cleaner & Sorter → Dataset Saver

agents.name: Lead Qualifier
agents.tagline: Hot, warm or cold, scored instantly
agents.description: Scores each new lead or enquiry using your rules and AI (budget, need, timeline, location), checks for duplicates and assigns it to the right person.
agents.everyday_use: Call the best leads first.
example_workflows: Webhook trigger → Lead Qualifier → CRM Sync → Alerts & Digest Sender

config.system: You qualify sales leads fairly, using only the details given.

agents.name: Auto Publisher
agents.tagline: Publish to your site and socials
agents.description: Publishes approved content to your connected website (Next.js, WordPress, Ghost) and channels (LinkedIn, Telegram, Slack…), and records every delivery.
agents.everyday_use: Publish everywhere with one approval.
example_workflows: Content Writer → SEO Optimizer → Auto Publisher

agents.name: CRM Sync
agents.tagline: Push leads and records into your CRM
agents.description: Sends each item to your CRM or internal system (Zoho, HubSpot, your own API) as a new lead or update, with fields mapped your way.
agents.everyday_use: Every enquiry lands in your CRM automatically.
example_workflows: Lead Qualifier → CRM Sync

agents.name: Google Sheets Sync
agents.tagline: Every result as a row in your sheet
agents.description: Adds each item as a new row in a Google Sheet through a small Apps Script web app (setup steps included). No Google login is stored in LayerFlow.
agents.everyday_use: Keep a live spreadsheet of everything your agents find.
example_workflows: Smart Web Scraper → Google Sheets Sync

agents.name: Alerts & Digest Sender
agents.tagline: Telegram, Slack, Discord or email alerts
agents.description: Sends a message for each important item, or one tidy digest, to Telegram, Slack, Discord, email or a webhook.
agents.everyday_use: Get the important stuff on your phone.
example_workflows: Page Change Watcher → Alerts & Digest Sender

agents.name: Comparison Assistant
agents.tagline: Visitors compare anything, in real time
agents.description: A chat assistant for your website that answers questions and compares records side by side (colleges, products, plans), always from your own data.
agents.everyday_use: Let visitors compare options on your website instantly.
example_workflows: Dataset → Comparison Assistant (website widget)

agents.name: Customer Support Assistant
agents.tagline: Answers customer questions 24×7
agents.description: Answers customer questions on your website from your FAQ and help content, and says so honestly when it doesn't know.
agents.everyday_use: Answer common questions even at midnight.
example_workflows: FAQ Generator → Dataset Saver → Customer Support Assistant

config.greeting: Hi! Ask me anything about our products and services.
config.instructions: Answer like a friendly support agent using only the FAQ entries. If they do not cover the question, say so honestly and suggest contacting support.

agents.name: Custom AI Agent
agents.tagline: Describe the job, get an agent
agents.description: Write instructions in plain English and choose the fields you want back. Use it for anything the other agents don't cover, like classifying, extracting, rewriting or scoring.
agents.everyday_use: Build your own agent for any task.
example_workflows: Any agent → Custom AI Agent → Dataset Saver

agents.name: SerpApi Live Search
agents.tagline: Real-time results from Google, not stale scraping
agents.description: Searches Google Web, News, Jobs, Shopping, Maps or Scholar through SerpApi and returns clean, structured results: title, snippet, publisher, date and URL. Can run several queries at once and enrich the top hits with the SerpApi Extract API.
agents.everyday_use: Ask a question and get fresh, structured web results in seconds.
capabilities: Web, News, Jobs, Shopping, Maps, Scholar
SerpApi Extract API for full page markdown
Cached so demo re-runs do not waste credits
example_workflows: SerpApi Live Search → Cited Answer Writer → Dataset Saver

pricing.note: Uses your SerpApi key; 500 bonus credits via the Beyond 9TO5 link.

agents.name: You.com Cited Researcher
agents.tagline: Answers you can actually verify
agents.description: Uses You.com's live web data to answer a question with numbered citations, or to build a cited brief from fresh web results. Every claim points back to a source, so you can check it in one click.
agents.everyday_use: Get a live answer with sources instead of an uncited guess.
capabilities: You.com Answer API with inline citations
Citations stored on the item for the assistant UI
example_workflows: You.com Cited Researcher → Dataset Saver → Comparison Assistant
